title: 러닝인 줄 알았는데 오픈런
scope: Five-scene 20-second cartoon Reel from existing selected art, with fixed Korean lettering, gentle zoom, licensed BGM, separate cover and caption.

method.derivatives: Pillow uniform-scale QA thumbnails and a labelled contact sheet only; original source PNG bytes preserved
method.reel: Pillow uniform resampling/100–103% zoom, reused balloon art, Gaegu lettering and local FFmpeg H.264/AAC. No new AI art in rendering step.

authorization.appliesTo: generating source artwork from the chosen 5-scene storyboard
authorization.revisionQuote: 오픈런 대기줄에 사람들도 구현했으면 좋겠어. 그리고 요즘 유행하는것처럼 한정선과 같이 흰색 찹쌀떡이면 좋을듯해.

sourceAndLineage.continuity: episode 4 woman and episode 3 torso correction; new episode 5 candidates carry recorded lineage
sourceAndLineage.preparations: preparation-*.json contain actual image order, roles, SHA-256 and exact prompt hashes
sourceAndLineage.generationRecords: generation-*.json retain original tool output paths and copied original-byte hashes

voiceRevisionAuthorization: 여성은 소녀 목소리였으면 좋겠고 장고는 장난꾸러기 아이같은 목소리로 재생성해줘.
